intent: Cover Longs, SC (Horry County) for backyard putting greens, residential turf and pet turf: the SC 9/SC 905 rural corridor, the 1980s-90s golf subdivisions, the newest builder communities, and Horry County vs. association permitting.
distinctValue: Four golf courses in Longs itself (Long Bay, Aberdeen, Colonial Charters, Crown Park); three distinct lot types (rural well-and-septic, golf subdivision, new builder community); Horry County stormwater permitting and the SC HOA recording-of-covenants rule.
